title: US flights recover after a nationwide ground stop caused by an air traffic system failure
caption:
A failure in US air traffic control systems led the FAA to halt departures nationwide for more than four hours on Friday. More than 2,000 US flights were cancelled on Saturday as airlines rebooked stranded passengers. Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy blamed overloaded old equipment, and officials say there is no sign of a cyberattack.

One story. Twice a day. Follow for the next edition.
